correctness.rationale: Substitution into the three source octics leaves one zero restriction and one common nonzero equation F. Its exact expansion has only normal degrees four and six, and the degree-four term is the product of the four displayed linear forms divided by sixteen. Their coefficient determinant is -16 p^2(1-p)^2, so for p not zero or one they are distinct and independent, giving order exactly four and a reduced four-hyperplane normal cone. The derivative gcd equals one, so the hypersurface equation is squarefree and agrees with the reduced section. The permutation symmetry transfers the statement to all nine components.
